title: Roamhaven Listings Extra-Guest Fee Ceiling — Desk Reference and Reset Tool
content:
# Extra-Guest Fee Ceiling and the Extra-Guest Fee Reset

*Host Support card for Roamhaven Listings.*

## The policy this card serves

A listing's extra-guest fee — the fee charged per night for each guest beyond the listing's extra-guest threshold — may be no higher than the listing's extra-guest ceiling. A fee standing above that ceiling is reset to the ceiling exactly, and the reset is logged as one change of the extra-guest fee. A fee at or below the ceiling is left as it stands. The reset leaves the extra-guest threshold as it stands.

| Extra-guest fee on the listing compared with the listing's extra-guest ceiling | Handling |
|---|---|
| above the ceiling | reset to the ceiling exactly; one change of the extra-guest fee is logged |
| at the ceiling | left as it stands |
| below the ceiling | left as it stands |

**Effect of a reset.** From the reset onward, new bookings of the listing are priced with the reset extra-guest fee; stays already booked keep the amounts frozen on them. The extra-guest threshold is not touched.

## Support tool: `reset_extra_guest_fee_9609655d`

**Capability.** Overwrites the per-night extra-guest fee of one host listing with the amount passed in, leaving the threshold as it stands. When the amount differs from the extra-guest fee the listing carried at the moment of the call, one fee-change record is added to the listing's history with the old amount, the new amount and today's date; an unchanged amount logs nothing.

**How it is invoked.** The tool is an agent-side tool: support unlocks `reset_extra_guest_fee_9609655d` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `listing_id` | the reference number of the host listing whose extra-guest fee is reset, as returned by the listing lookup for the verified host | the listing reference number |
| `extra_guest_fee` | the fee per extra guest per night | a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before saving; 0.00 means extra guests are not charged |

**Return.** A receipt carrying `listing_id` (the listing reference number), `setting` (always `extra_guest_fee`), `previous_amount` (the extra-guest fee the listing carried when the call was made, USD to 2 decimal places), `new_amount` (the extra-guest fee now saved, USD to 2 decimal places), `change_logged` (true when a fee-change record was added), `change_record_id` (the reference number of that record, empty when nothing was logged) and `saved_on` (the date of the save, YYYY-MM-DD). The call has completed when the receipt comes back with the listing reference number and the new amount; a receipt carrying the new amount means the reset is in force.

## Question the card answers

**Does a reset of the extra-guest fee change the number of guests from which the fee is charged?**
No. The reset leaves the extra-guest threshold as it stands.
